items.context: Is this your payment or someone else`s?

items.text: there is a debit from my account i did not make
someone has withdrawn five thousand rupees without my permission
i found a transaction on the fifth of march which is not mine
please check there is a payment of two thousand rupees i did not do
i want to report an unauthorised transaction from last week
the transaction at the electronics store was not approved by me

items.context: Can you confirm the transaction amount?
items.text: it shows a purchase of three thousand but i never authorised it
the date of transaction is twentieth april but i was not near that place

items.context: Where did the transaction take place?
items.text: my card shows a debit of four hundred rupees at a restaurant i never visited

items.context: Can you provide the merchant details?
items.text: the transaction with merchant code 12345 is not done by me
i noticed an unauthorised debit of seven thousand five hundred rupees on my bank statement yesterday evening please assist
there is a withdrawal of ten thousand rupees done through my account on the tenth of april which i did not approve please help me report this

items.context: Can you provide more details about the unauthorised transaction?
items.text: i want to report an unauthorised transaction of six thousand rupees on fifteenth march which is not done by me please help me block my card

items.context: Please explain what happened with the transaction in detail
items.text: this debit transaction at the grocery store on first april was not made by me and it has deducted five thousand rupees from my account please let me know how to proceed

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: unauthorised_debit - reports a transaction they did not make
Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
